page.layout: One page of running text, with a copperplate illustration of a watchtower and soldier below the text. Margin notes in the right margin, beside lines 4, 7 and 10 of the text. Running head at top, page number at top right. Left edge shows the neighbouring page (not transcribed).

main_text.p: mam;ut procul spectantibus vera castra viderentur. Quos scilicet ignes ita structos, in noctem & Vigilias producebant, donec paullatim exstinguerentur. Etsi tamen de Facibus proprie ad Vigilias, aliquid ex Dionysio suspi-cere,Tamen & Faces alia. qui supra φέγξη[?] λαμπάδων signanter dixit, id est Fa-cium lumina. Item Statio, qui & ipse verbo Facium vsus:

Incertaq; faces, & iam male peruigil ignis.Lib.viii. de languidis excubiis & remissis, vti Tacitus inualidos ignes. Atque idem Statius, vbi crebras excubias & desas notat, Contractaq; vices, & crebrior excubat ignis.Lib.xii.
Quin & in Columna Traiani, vbi Vigiles ponuntur, video super eos in turris fenestra exsertam facem: quid? ad illucendum, & vt accedentes noscerent? opinor.

page.notes: Engraving below the text, not transcribed as text: a Roman watchtower with a torch flaming from a window or balcony, a wooden palisade in front, and a soldier with a shield and helmet pointing to the flame. Doubtful readings: the Greek word after "φέγ" (marked [?]); "mam;" is a fragment carried over from the previous page. Printed "Lib.viii." and "Lib.xii." are marginal references, taken as printed. Long s has been normalised to s. Greek letters and accents are copied as seen; check against the scan.
